text: Breakthrough experiments were performed in a custom-built fixed-bed reactor using dried resin samples (90–100 mg) packed in a 1/4″ stainless-steel tube (∼5 cm length, 4 mm i.d.), sealed with glass wool. [...] Breakthrough tests were then conducted with dry or humid (0% and 70% RH) 400 ppm CO2/N2 (40 sccm), with humidity regulated by a WETSYS/SETARAM humidifier and outlet CO2/H2O concentrations monitored using a LI-850 (LI-COR) infrared gas analyzer.

source.title: In situ azetidine polymerization elevates the performance of commercial polymer resin sorbents in carbon dioxide capture
